faqs.q: Do you train all breeds of dogs?
faqs.a: Yes, we have experience of training almost all breeds of dogs.

faqs.q: How much do the courses cost, and do the later courses cost the same?
faqs.a: Each course page shows its price just under the heading. At the moment Puppy Socialisation is £59.99, Junior and Bronze are £119.99, and Silver, Gold and Platinum are £129.99, so the courses from Silver onwards cost a little more.

faqs.q: Which course should my dog start on: Puppy Socialisation, Junior or Bronze?
faqs.a: It depends on your dog's age. Puppy Socialisation is for pups up to 6 months, the Junior course is for young dogs aged 6 to 12 months, and Bronze is for dogs 12 months of age and upward. Junior through to Platinum is a step-by-step progression, and Puppy Socialisation is a standalone class, so your puppy does not need it before starting Junior. If you're not sure, tell Gaynor a little about your dog and she will come back to you with whether it's the right course to start on.

faqs.q: Do I need a group course, a one to one, or a behavioural consultation?
faqs.a: Group courses are for obedience and everyday manners — lead walking, recall, sit and down, stays — taught step by step over six weeks. A one to one is a bespoke session on whatever you are finding difficult, and suits owners who work shifts or can't commit to a weekly class, who want to get further than a class will take them, who feel self-conscious training in front of others, or whose dog's temperament doesn't suit a class. A behavioural consultation is for a behaviour problem rather than a training gap: aggression towards dogs or people, growling or biting, destruction, boisterousness you can't control, or a dog you can't leave alone. If you're not sure, tell Gaynor a little about your dog when you get in touch and she will say where to start.

faqs.q: Do we have to book into the Bronze obedience course?
faqs.a: Yes, you do have to book into the Bronze obedience course, as this is a course that runs for six consecutive weeks.

faqs.q: Can children come to the obedience courses?
faqs.a: Because the people in the obedience courses are constantly on the move and changing direction, children have to sit on the side and watch. Many do, and they are welcome.

faqs.q: Do we have to pay in advance when we book into the obedience course?
faqs.a: A non-refundable £50 deposit by bank transfer secures your place (this isn't required for the Puppy Socialisation course). Any remaining balance is paid on the first week when you arrive.

We now run from two venues near Swansea: the A1K9 Training Grounds, and Llys Nini Animal Centre (RSPCA), Penllergaer, for indoor sessions. Gaynor will confirm which one your session is at, usually depending on the weather. (See directions on website)

faqs.q: Does my dog need to have had kennel cough vaccination to come to classes?
faqs.a: No, your dog does not need to have kennel cough vaccination to come to training classes, but their yearly vaccinations need to be up to date.

faqs.q: What do I need to bring with me?
faqs.a: Collar, lead and some treats that your dogs like to eat. We also sell good quality training equipment.
You should wear warm clothes and sturdy shoes as we will work outdoors whenever possible.

faqs.q: If I miss a week in a course can I have that credited on the next course?
faqs.a: Sorry, no, you cannot, as the courses run in six consecutive weeks and you have paid for those dates.

faqs.q: If it is raining will the class be cancelled?
faqs.a: No, it will be held indoors at Llys Nini Animal Centre (RSPCA), Penllergaer, instead.
